extract_minicpmv_projector: extract the multimodal projector weights from a MiniCPM-V model and save as minicpmv.projector
extract_clip_vision_weights: extract the CLIP/vision encoder weights from a MiniCPM-V model and save as minicpmv.clip
clear_added_tokens: clear added_tokens.json to enable Mistral model conversion compatibility
rewrite_llm_config_auto_map: rewrite the LLM config auto_map to use MiniCPM model classes for HuggingFace auto-loading
prepare_model_for_gguf_conversion: prepare a MiniCPM-V model and tokenizer for conversion to a regular LLaMA GGUF file
